Every row foots, so the fault is not arithmetic. Revenue of 25,075 less 2,043 returns equals the reported 23,032, and all subtotals tie. However, the cut-off review shows 2,579 was billed for performance obligations still unsatisfied at period-end, and only 127 was deferred. That implies about 2,452 was recognised before the obligations were satisfied, so revenue is overstated. The figure rests on that supporting fact alone.
